name: Oc hut
summary: Ốc hút is named on the indoor counters at Con Market, on Phạm Hồng Thái at night, and in the Con Market snack row on the 12 Jun 2026 markets page. None of those pages describe the snail.
origin: Named as a Da Nang snack. A species and a sauce were not printed.
howToEat: The city pages name ốc hút and do not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Con Market’s indoor counters, on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup and the 4 Oct 2024 market page. The 12 Jun 2026 page puts it in the snack row with bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo, kem bơ, and chè. Phạm Hồng Thái names it at night on the 2019 page.
seoTitle: Oc hut — a Da Nang snack name
seoDescription: Da Nang names ốc hút at Con Market and on Phạm Hồng Thái. The pages do not describe the snail. Check on arrival.
